messages:
Maya: anyone up for the 12:30 parkrun today? 5k from the office, meet at the fountain. small prize: the loser buys granola.
Ben: I'm in. Can only do 4 laps max tho. :runner:
Clara: tempted but climbing sesh at 1:30. can I come for the warmup walk?
Dan: I'll race you, Maya. Loser does handshake with the office plant? :joy:
Erin: Granola debate: is 'store' acceptable or do we demand homemade? :yum:
Ben: store-bought is pro, homemade is cheating. :sunglasses:
Maya: officially calling it: 12:25 meet, 12:30 start. stakes: loser buys granola & does the plant handshake.
FitBot: Reminder: 12:30 parkrun registered. Weather: 63F, light rain, trail muddy. Don't forget trail shoes.
Clara: ugh rain. do we want to move to stairs if it's slippery? thoughts?
Maya: let's keep it outdoor but take it easy if soggy. stairs as backup: 12:45 at stairwell B.
Dan: also bringing a tiny trophy (it's actually a sock with googly eyes). :trophy:
Erin: if I win, I'm picking the playlist. no corporate training tracks allowed. :face_with_raised_eyebrow:
Ben: Deal. Also quick heads-up: if anyone wants to join bouldering after (3pm) @Clara said there's space.
Clara: 3pm at the new gym route setter. Noobs welcome.
Maya: perfect. See y'all. PS: I made a sign-up so we know granola preference: https://tinyurl.com/ggranola
Ben: signed up. prefers almond.
Dan: signed. prefers peanut butter.
Erin: signed. homemade allegro.
Maya: good. See you at the fountain. :thumbsup:
